title: surface-render-v10 — browser signature verification
description: The signed bundle export verified in Chromium with the shipped COSE + WebCrypto path, before anything renders. Captured by driving the running app with Playwright.

primitivesUsed.note: All shipped, all unchanged. Ed25519 verified natively in Chromium WebCrypto. The only new code is the caller.

cleanExport.affirmation: I have reviewed this release and I stand behind what each page in it claims to be.
cleanExport.shellHeadline: This app is exactly what R. Okonjo, Product Owner signed off.

falsification.what: One character altered in the export: documents[theme].tokens['color.accent'] #7A1F3D -> #7A1F3E
falsification.appBehaviour: Boot refuses. Nothing from the bundle reaches the screen — the person sees a refusal, not an app with a warning on it.

methodUriProvenance: Read out of the COSE protected header, never out of the JSON record beside it, so a record claiming a method the envelope does not carry cannot pass.
